title: Estimator program cost
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and let $S\subseteq J$. Every outcome $(q,c)$ in the support of the estimator program's cost distribution for target $f$ has cost component $c$ equal to the restricted Fourier weight estimator cost: zero random examples, $2m$ membership queries, and $3mn+m(2+(2n+2|S|+1))+(m+1)$ units of local work.
hypotheses_covered: target Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
outcome belongs to the support of the program's cost distribution
